conviction_note: Nothing decisive and unpriced: the H1 guide (OP 4,100m) and FY guide (OP 10,000m) were raised on 2026-07-31 and IFIS consensus now sits exactly on them; the company did not pre-release an H1 deviation this year though it usually does, so the quarter probably lands inside the plan, and when this name has held its plan at an H1 print (2024, 2025) the stock fell 5-7%. The small negatives here rest on public facts and a crowded margin long, so p_up sits only slightly below 50 (47) on a 6% scale. The findings sum (-1.0) and the scaled number (-0.36) share a sign; the scaled number is smaller because LESSONS rule 1 pulls p_up toward 50 for negatives built on public series.

positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-27 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, per sealed baseline). Margin ratio (信用倍率) 29.79x per the baseline and kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6023, 2026-10-28), so leveraged retail is crowded long. No skew exists (no listed single-stock options). Run-up -10.38% over 20 days, -1.32% over 5. The drawdown is sector-wide: 10/20 and 10/22 hit the shipbuilding/marine-engine theme (Japan Engine 6016 -6.0% and -10.8%, Mitsui E&S 7003 -4.3% and -3.7%, per Yahoo chart data), with no company-specific disclosure for 6023.

findings.finding: The company files no H1 deviation notice before this print, although it filed a separate 業績予想の修正 about a week before the H1 print in 2020 (10/22), 2021 (10/22), 2022 (10/21) and 2025 (10/23). The irbank disclosure list shows nothing after the 2026-07-31 Q1 batch. This points to H1 landing inside the TSE deviation band of 4,100m OP (no large surprise on the period), and the company has raised its FY plan AT the H1 print only once in five years (2023-10-26, with a dividend increase).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 prints, previous close to next close: 2023-10-26 FY raised plus dividend raised at the print, +3.8%; 2024-10-29 plan held, -6.9% (it opened +4% and was sold); 2025-10-30 plan held after a pre-release on 10/23, -5.1%; 2022-10-27 after a pre-release, +6.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: The deviation-notice habit is not in any aggregator's consensus. If the market had read it, nobody would be positioned for an H1 upgrade, and the 29.8x margin long suggests some holders are. It cuts only partly: a concurrent raise as in 2023 stays possible.
findings.independence: Revision history from a separate source: https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=6023 (FY plan unchanged at the 2024-10-29 and 2025-10-30 H1 prints, changed at 2023-10-26).

findings.finding: Q1 OP of 2,289m is 22.9% of the raised FY plan, against this company's own Q1 share of the final FY OP of 19.5% (FY3/26: 1,487/7,621) and 20.4% (FY3/25: 1,555/7,634). The H1 guide needs only Q2 OP of 1,811m, against 976m a year earlier. Marine-engine segment profit rose 33% in Q1 on engine sales and maintenance demand, and Japanese yards report high order books.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A strong Q1 on 2026-07-31 (OP +54%, with a guide raise) gave +4.2% on the day and +5.8% the next session. An in-line H1 in 2024 was sold.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: anyone can compute it from the Q1 短信. It is filed because the plan is conservative against the company's own seasonality, which keeps a small upside tail on H1 and a later raise. If fully priced, the stock would not be 10% below where it stood in early October.
findings.independence: Quarterly series on kabutan: https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6023 (Q2 OP: 1,628m in 2024, 976m in 2025).

findings.finding: The yen strengthened over Q2 from the level at which the 2026-07-31 FX-driven raise was made (USD/JPY month-end about 160.1 in July, then 157.4 and 156.9; EUR/JPY 185.6, then 178.5 and 175.7). This trims the room for another FX-led upgrade at H1, although USD/JPY is still about 10 yen weaker than a year earlier (about 147-154).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-07-31 raise was attributed to a weaker yen plus maintenance demand, and the stock rose +4.2% and then +5.8%. There is no separate FX-only episode to cite.
findings.why_not_priced: This is macro-to-company transmission. The company's assumed rate after the revision is not disclosed in anything I could reach, so the market cannot price this exactly either. Sized small as an inference.

findings.finding: The margin long is crowded at 29.8x into a theme drawdown of -10% in 20 sessions, and on its two most recent H1 prints with the plan held the stock fell 5-7% to the next close. A 13:00 in-session release with no FY raise has leveraged sellers waiting.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the baseline lean already carries a margin-overhang term of -0.74, and the 20-day drawdown has flushed some longs. If it were fully priced, the margin ratio would have come down from about 30x during the drawdown, and it has not. Sized below the history because only one of the two drawdowns was this name's own.

baseline_tension: My small negative agrees with the margin-overhang term and the run-up direction of the baseline lean (-0.22), so most of it is probably priced. The strongest positive the release could carry is a concurrent FY raise with 増配, as at the 2023 H1 print: Q1 ran ahead of the company's own seasonality and the plan has been raised repeatedly. A buyback or a sell-out of bad news after a 10% sector drawdown is the other route up. I looked for evidence of either and found none, but neither is ruled out.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the negatives rest on public facts (the disclosure habit, FX, the margin ratio), so p_up moved from 45 to 47 and expected_move_pct from -0.60 to -0.36; the finding sizes are unchanged because their caveats were already sized in.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): three of four findings are negative, so the strongest positive (an FY raise with 増配, a buyback) is written into baseline_tension; I had looked for it, so nothing further moved.
